name: SMPY
title: SM regression estimator using Pen~a-Yohai candidates
description:
This function computes a robust regression estimator when there
are categorical / dummy explanatory variables. It uses Pen~a-Yohai
candidates for the S-estimator. This function is used
internally by ``lmrobdetMM``, and not meant to be used
directly.

arguments.description: a list of control parameters as returned by ``lmrobdet.control``

a list as returned by `splitFrame` containing the continuous and
dummy components of the design matrix

author: Victor Yohai, <victoryohai@gmail.com>, Matias Salibian-Barrera, <matias@stat.ubc.ca>
